NRC - EMOTION WORD Classification
```{r emotion_Classification}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(ggplot2)

# Loading NRC Emotion Lexicon
nrc <- get_sentiments("nrc")

# Tokenizing the text
emotion_tokens <- posts_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(post)) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, post) %>%
  inner_join(nrc, by = "word")  # This will Join with NRC lexicon

# This will Count emotions per post
emotion_counts <- emotion_tokens %>%
  count(YearMonth, sentiment = sentiment)

# Filtering for specific emotions
dominant_emotions <- emotion_counts %>%
  filter(sentiment %in% c("fear", "anger", "trust", "joy", "sadness", "anticipation"))

# Plotting emotion trends over time
ggplot(dominant_emotions, aes(x = YearMonth, y = n, color = sentiment, group = sentiment)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Emotion Trends in COVID-19 Discourse Over Time",
       x = "Year-Month", y = "Number of Emotion Words") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

Exporting the Output as a CSV file.

```{r emotion_Classification_csv}
write.csv(dominant_emotions, 
          file = "C:/Users/ademi/Desktop/Thesis/emotion_Classification.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)
```

Applying sentiment score using syuzhet: get_sentiment returns numeric score

```{r sentiment Analysis, cache=TRUE}
#Ensuring text is character and removing missing rows
posts_df <- posts_df %>% filter(!is.na(post))
posts_df$post <- as.character(posts_df$post)

# Applying sentiment score using syuzhet (get_sentiment returns numeric score)
posts_df$sentiment_score <- get_sentiment(posts_df$post, method = "syuzhet")

# Sentiment classified as Positive, Neutral, or Negative
posts_df$sentiment_label <- case_when(
  posts_df$sentiment_score > 0 ~ "Positive",
  posts_df$sentiment_score < 0 ~ "Negative",
  TRUE ~ "Neutral"
)
```

How has public sentiment evolved from 2020 to 2024

```{r puublic_sentiment_evolve}
sentiment_trend <- posts_df %>%
  group_by(YearMonth, sentiment_label) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(sentiment_trend, aes(x = YearMonth, y = count, color = sentiment_label, group = sentiment_label)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Monthly Sentiment Trends", x = "Year-Month", y = "Number of Posts") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

Sentiment Distribution by Language

```{r Top10_Words_Language_Sentiment}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)

# Define custom stop words (same as before)
custom_stopwords <- c(
  "covid", "coronavirus", "covidtesting", "covidpandemic", "covidvaccine",
  "covidupdate", "coronavirusupdates", "coronaviruspandemic",
  "link", "time", "https", "bio", "afccares", "people", "india"
)

# Tokenize and clean text
tidy_lang <- posts_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(post), Language %in% c("English", "Spanish")) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, post) %>%
  filter(str_detect(word, "^[a-zA-Z]+$")) %>%
  filter(!word %in% stop_words$word) %>%
  filter(!word %in% custom_stopwords)

# Count top 10 words by Language and Sentiment
top_words_lang_sent <- tidy_lang %>%
  count(Language, sentiment_label, word, sort = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(Language, sentiment_label) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot: Facet by Language and Sentiment
ggplot(top_words_lang_sent, aes(x = reorder(word, n), y = n, fill = sentiment_label)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(Language ~ sentiment_label, scales = "free_y") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Words by Language and Sentiment",
    x = "Words", y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Positive" = "blue", "Neutral" = "green", "Negative" = "red")) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r top_words_by_language_sentiment_csv}

          file = "C:/Users/ademi/Desktop/Thesis/top_words_by_language_sentiment.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```
